summary: Validated orders-only staff role gating + order weight + Google Maps link across backend and frontend. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases pass — admin login returns role='admin' and hits products/offers/shipping/dashboard/orders (all 200); both staff accounts (+355690000002 and +355690000003) login with role='orders_staff', can list/get/patch orders (200) and are blocked (403) from products, offers, settings/shipping and dashboard/summary. Frontend: staff sees ONLY the Orders tab (Dashboard, Products, Offers, Shipping hidden) and direct nav to /admin/products or /admin redirects to /admin/orders; full admin sees all five tabs. Order cards show weight (e.g. '3 items · 550 g', '4 items · 4.00 kg') with a 'Map' pill; order detail shows a 'Total weight' row and an 'Open in Google Maps' CTA; staff successfully changed order status via UI (confirmation dialog + PATCH).
critical_code_review_comments: security.require_admin / require_orders_staff correctly gate on effective_role; legacy admins (no role field) still treated as admin via effective_role fallback — good backward compat.
seed.py force-resets staff password/role on every startup, which keeps credentials stable across deploys.
seed_data_creation: None — relied on existing seeded orders (17 present).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login phone field has a hard-coded +355 prefix; UI tests must send only local digits (e.g. '690000002'), not the full E.164 number. Login button text is 'Sign in to admin'. Order cards use data-testid orders-row-<id>, map pill orders-map-<id>; detail screen has od-maps, od-set-<status>, od-advance, od-cancel. Staff accounts: +355690000002 / +355690000003 with password admin#123.
rca_of_issue: N/A — implementation verified end-to-end, no bugs found.
